searchText: MSRP $207,907. New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Quantum Sprinter Mercedes Diesel Model GL24. Features Full Body Paint Auto Leveling Jacks Child Safety Net More About This RV This Luxury RV measures approximately 25 feet 10 inches in length and rides on the premier Mercedes Benz Sprinter chassis equipped with an Active Braking Assist system, Attention Assist, Active Lane Assist, a Wet Wiper System and Distance Regulator Distronic Plus. You will also find a tank-less water heater, generator and the ultra-high-line cabinetry from TMC that set this coach apart from the competition! The all new Quantum Sprinter also features a fiberglass front cap with skylight, an power patio awning with integrated LED lighting, a multimedia dash radio with Bluetooth and navigation, remote exterior mirrors, back up system, swivel captain’s chairs, keyless entry, valve stem extensions, full extension metal ball-bearing drawer guides, 12v refrigerator with auto generator start, solid surface kitchen countertop, convection microwave oven with air fryer, outside shower, solar, holding tanks with heat pads and much more.
